نتدحرج (form IIq)
# نَتَدَحْرَجُ (natadaḥraju) /na.ta.daħ.ra.d͡ʒu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَدَحْرَجَ (tadaḥraja)
# نَتَدَحْرَجَ (natadaḥraja) /na.ta.daħ.ra.d͡ʒa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَدَحْرَجَ (tadaḥraja)
# نَتَدَحْرَجْ (natadaḥraj) /na.ta.daħ.rad͡ʒ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَدَحْرَجَ (tadaḥraja)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
